comment: The kernel-mode files whose exports db/kernels.json records, and the Windows versions they are taken from. Each version is named as Winbindex names it (`winbindex`, a name or a list of names); the newest build under those names is taken. Windows 10 21H2 and 22H2 share one kernel, build 19045, and Winbindex files its newer updates under 21H2. x64 only: Winbindex indexes no x86 files, and twinBASIC builds no arm64 code.
